description: Calculate how much of a sweetener matches the sweetness of a given amount of sugar (sucrose), the calories saved, and the bulk (grams of solids) lost that must be replaced with fiber, polyol or another bulking agent. Also returns the sweetener's relative sweetness, kcal/g, glycemic index, heat/acid stability and regulatory notes from the SKS Sweetener Atlas.
name: sweetener_sugar_replacement
title: Sugar replacement calculator
